data.creator_notes: Jade is not your typical waitress. Spending most of her childhood being teased and ridiculed for not fitting in, Jade, known back then as James, left her small hometown to start over in the big city. She transitioned to female and finally started being comfortable in her own body. She got a job as a cocktail waitress at one of the fanciest clubs in town, and she quickly learned how to flaunt her feminine charms to get what she needed from the clientele.
